entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This elevator will most likely take us[n]to Sae-san's location.
entries.uk: Цей ліфт, найімовірніше, довезе[n]нас до Сае.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis... I'll protect you, no matter[n]what it takes.
entries.uk: Сестро... Я захищу тебе,[n]хай там що.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Hm? Do you need time to make[n]preparations?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We don't have much time to waste[n]though! Hurry, hurry!
entries.uk: Але часу в нас обмаль![n]Швидше, швидше!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Are you ready to get going?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We must hurry after Sae-san for[n]the time being! Let us go!
entries.uk: Поки що треба поспішати[n]за Сае! Ходімо!
